support1: At Perccent, Cybrilla and a few platforms before them, the work has always circled the same question — what does this person actually need to see to make a good decision, and what can we remove.
support2: Outside work, I make time for long walks, old books and conversations that wander somewhere useful.
currentlyExploring: Behavioural finance, decision design, and why simplicity is harder to ship than features.
name: Piyush Roy
lede: I'm Piyush, based in New Delhi. I spend my time making investment products simpler than the industry usually allows.
quote: The best interfaces disappear. The best decisions feel obvious in hindsight.
